notice: Synthetic educational fixtures. Not real patients and not medical advice.

cases.name: explicit_negation

patient_sentences.text: The patient has no prior chemotherapy.

cases.expected_behaviour: The model must not treat the negation as evidence of prior chemotherapy.

cases.name: family_history_is_not_patient_history

patient_sentences.text: Her mother had a BRCA1 mutation.
The patient has not been tested for BRCA1 or BRCA2.

cases.expected_behaviour: Family history is not the patient's own genotype; a negative or absent test needs review.

cases.name: temporal_qualifier
cases.criterion_text: Myocardial infarction within the previous 3 months

patient_sentences.text: The patient had an uncomplicated myocardial infarction two years ago.
She has no chest pain today.

cases.expected_behaviour: A two-year-old event is outside the three-month window.

cases.name: lexical_contradiction

patient_sentences.text: The patient has no prior chemotherapy.

cases.expected_behaviour: The service must set the contradiction flag and require review.

cases.name: exclusion_inversion
cases.criterion_text: Severe anemia with hemoglobin below 7 g/dL

patient_sentences.text: The patient has a history of severe anemia.
No current hemoglobin value is available.

cases.expected_behaviour: Do not turn an exclusion into inclusion; missing current laboratory data requires review.
